cases.name: Trisha Lynn Fernandez
cases.about:
She was Filipina. Her obituary said, "Trisha spent the rest of her childhood growing up in Chula Vista, CA where she attended Olympicview Elementary School Eastlake Middle School, and Eastlake High School. It was during her high school years where Trisha became a member of the prestigious Eastlake High School Color Guard team. She participated in numerous competitions and helped the team win several awards. One of the most notable displays of her talent was a solo performance where she received high praise and accolades from the audience and her peers. In the two years following her high school graduation, Trisha remained dedicated to the team by volunteering as an Alumni Coach.

At the age of 20, Trisha decided to move to Oklahoma where she aspired to join the U.S. Air Force. While in Oklahoma, Trisha worked hard and obtained experience in the food and customer service industries. Trisha flourished as an Assistant Manager for Edible Arrangements. She was a diligent worker with a lot of potential and was months away from a promotion within the company.

In her free time, Trisha enjoyed singing, dancing, staying connected with friends and family, having fun at parties, and living life to the fullest.

Many people knew her to be a talented performer, genuinely and naturally great with children, and heartily devoted to her family. Most of all, Trisha will be remembered for her cheerful disposition, bright smile, and caring nature."
